trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is nothing else to do for it. Plan on roughly 200 hours across the three roadmap stages below; the long grind is the 100% checklist, 250 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, after the first main mission of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after its final main mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of the game — the last gold before the platinum chase begins in free roam.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — roughly 60% of the game — with only 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 15 of 18 meditations needed. Nothing on it is missable; everything can still be done in free roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix categories — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track them by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt. Check your count in Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most unlock naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The medals are not too hard, and range play also levels your Focus, which helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). Any single win at each location counts.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race locations are spread across Leonida; each unique race only needs one win, and race wins also feed the activity count for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines). Finishing all levels once is enough — you don't need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line (Lucia only): it opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls and marks his shop in Key Lento (green KR icon). Clear 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons, you dig treasure from the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County; it opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain lines count — confirmed so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. All available after the story; more strands are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso) he wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list; cars he marks appear in fixed spots, often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line (Jason only): after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only one: an early session, Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house, only happens in Chapter 1 (morning after Down to Earth: talk to her in the kitchen, follow her out and choose Accept). It is unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting line (Jason only): after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; hunt the animals he marks (purple icons) and bring them back. It is still being confirmed which exact animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 set locations. You don't need every set — any 3 will do.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are more than 100 — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, so scan whatever you pass while doing everything else.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70). Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally; save this for late and pick the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (call them with Right + Triangle, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), build a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Easiest: drive a fast bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops back to back without losing your wanted level — keep the flashing wanted level alive the whole time. Bring armor, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) work well; the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan). You don't need to drive them — stand on a busy road and scan traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so buff Focus first (food, drink, washing up, Adrenaline) and line up a group — gang operations are good for this. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest; drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. You must fly about 1 km away before it pops. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies), break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it — kicking trips the alarm. Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and instantly gives a 4-star wanted level. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It counts automatically when you rob a large bank vault in That's Where The Money Is… (the same mission as Maximum Withdrawal). Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it, grab the cash and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — fly a plane over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. A plane is the fastest way to cover the whole state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist; the 100% checklist needs all of them). They show as yellow icons when you get near, and many are marked from story progress. Track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Try it in free roam once you can reach Ocean Beach; this guide will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. The pop is slightly delayed; only this blue Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn), steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break lets you switch freely. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner with Right + Triangle and the other finishes training automatically. Gyms are listed under Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (view the count by clicking the trophy in the list). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see a demon face whenever an action counts. Robberies and fights feed it passively; if you still need some at the end, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile — cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description ('Second time's the charm') is the only hint. Try it in free roam; this guide will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. The description ('What the hell just happened?') is the only hint. This guide will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by). Try it in free roam; this guide will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays best). First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the bills to a fence — the total counts across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest. Any shop type counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app — it installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages don't count. Robberies, especially the high-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds parking spots — then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register. He only takes tracker-free cars at first; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars keep the cost down.
